evals.prompt: Add a retry limit to the uploader. It currently retries forever.
evals.expected_output: A failing test is written first and watched failing for the right reason, then the smallest code makes it pass, the full suite runs, and refactoring is a separate commit.
expectations: The test is written before the implementation.
The reply shows the test failing for the intended reason before the fix.
The full Run & verify command is run, not only the new test.
Refactoring happens with the suite green and behaviour unchanged.

evals.prompt: Fix the bug where a transfer can be submitted twice in the same minute. There is no regression test yet.
evals.expected_output: The fix starts with a regression test that fails for the bug's reason, then fixes the shared cause, and runs the full suite.
expectations: A regression test is written first.
The reply watches the test fail before fixing the code.
The fix lands in the shared code path, not each caller.
The full suite is green after the fix.
